summary.headline: Planetary Orbs and Application
summary.text: Discussion of planetary orbs and the stages of application: conjunction, strongest application, and complete application. It gives orb measures for the superior planets, Mars, Sun, inferior planets, Moon, and lunar nodes, followed by a numerical example of the Moon applying to the Sun’s sextile.
